items.Sentence: Raw wastewater enters the Facility by way of two grinder pumps.
From the headworks, influent enters the primary clarifier in the center and is directed towards the bottoms of the tank by use of a stilling baffle.
Effluent from primary clarifier is fed by gravity into a fixed film reactor sump, where it is then pumped over the fixed film reactor along with a percentage of recirculation water.
...the remainder is pumped to two secondary sedimentation tanks.
Effluent from the secondary sedimentation tanks is disinfected with sodium hypochlorite.

Biosolids that are collected and pumped to the anaerobic digester are disposed of by pumping the solids directly from the bottom of the digester through a 3-inch cam fitting and trucking the material off-site.
...trucking the material off-site for further processing.
